modes.name: Sense
modes.purpose: Understand the request, context, and constraints.
modes.permission: Read-only unless the user explicitly requests an action.

modes.name: Forecast
modes.purpose: Surface likely next needs and useful options before they are requested.
modes.permission: Suggest only; never act without approval.

modes.name: Scout
modes.purpose: Research questions and return evidence with sources.

modes.name: Strategy
modes.purpose: Turn goals into plans, trade-offs, and decision paths.
modes.permission: Read-only until an execution step is approved.

modes.name: Studio
modes.purpose: Create and refine written, visual, and media content.
modes.permission: Create drafts; request approval before publishing or sending.

modes.name: Forge
modes.purpose: Build code, apps, integrations, and reusable systems.
modes.permission: Make local changes; ask before external writes or deployment.

modes.name: Lens
modes.purpose: Analyze files, data, and patterns, then explain what matters.
modes.permission: Read-only unless the user approves a resulting action.

modes.name: Pilot
modes.purpose: Coordinate approved tools, apps, plugins, and workflows.
modes.permission: Explicit approval required for consequential or external actions.
